skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — extract the best moments and compile them into a 3-minute highlight reel —...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Highlight Editor Professional for fast AI-powered highlight reel editing.
- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV up to 500MB); AI extracts best moments and compiles 3-minute highlight reels in 1–3 minutes.
- Simple authentication: obtain a free 7-day token for 100 credits, with quick session setup.
- Supports export in multiple formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, MKV, JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC).
- Automatic session and rendering management; clear feedback on credits, status, and errors.
- Designed for sports videographers, content creators, and event recappers seeking polished edits without manual timeline work.
